**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

I checked for any MFN-style covenant binding PB and found none:

- Searches for "most favored/favoured", "no less favo(u)rable", "favorable", "at least as", "terms no less", "preferential", "third party offer", "right of first refusal", and "right of first negotiation" returned essentially nothing on point.
- The only "not less favorable" hit (p0543, Article 7 security interest) requires any *replacement subordination agreement* with a new lender to be on terms not less favorable to SFJ than the SVB subordination agreement. That is a lien-priority/refinancing protection, not an obligation to extend SFJ better commercial terms given to third parties — outside the scope of this rule.
- The Licensing Transaction provisions (Section 7.5.5, p0552–p0554) give SFJ a consent right over non-Excluded Licensing Transactions, gated by a "Material Impact" standard and arbitration. It restricts PB's freedom to license, but imposes no matching/pass-through of third-party terms, so it is not an MFN (and any concern there belongs to a separate assignment/licensing-restriction rule, not this one).

Result: the Agreement sits at the **preferred** position — no MFN obligation on PB.
